results.title: South Brazil weather in November
results.snippet: Average daytime temperatures around 24C with roughly 15 rainy days.

results.title: Climate of South Brazil
results.snippet: Subtropical highland and humid subtropical climates dominate the region.

content.text: Southern Brazil in mid-November is warm and comfortable, averaging about 24C by day and 18C at night, with roughly 15 rainy days across the month.
